import json,runpy,time,sys
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict
import os
from spacepdhcg.gtoc12.low_thrust import ScvxSettings,solve_leg,certify_leg
fixture=runpy.run_path('tests/test_gtoc12_gpu_discretisation.py')
rows=[]
for repeat in range(2):
    start=time.perf_counter()
    solution=solve_leg(fixture['synthetic_boundary'](),ScvxSettings(discretisation_backend='cuda',
        assembly_backend='cuda',convex_solver_backend='qoco',outer_loop_backend=os.environ['SCVX_OUTER'],max_iterations=30,time_limit_s=30))
    seconds=time.perf_counter()-start
    certificate=certify_leg(solution)
    rows.append(dict(warmup=repeat==0,seconds=seconds,status=solution.status,mass=solution.final_mass_kg,
        qualified=bool(solution.converged and certificate.within_tolerance and abs(solution.final_mass_kg-2445.3111007852112)<=1e-5),
        certificate=asdict(certificate),outer_transfer_bytes=solution.outer_transfer_bytes,seed_backend=solution.seed_backend,reports=solution.solver_reports,history=solution.history))
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
print(rows[-1]['qualified'],rows[-1]['seconds'],flush=True)

isolated_resources_memcheck.scope: New resource swapping/retention/destruction and cuBLAS operations; does not cover conditional graph execution.

failures_and_limits: No additional end-to-end speedup over v121 demonstrated: medians121332.363ms/cached123340.241ms/uncached123387.147ms; unlocked display GPU, six balanced measurements per variant.

v122 timing overlapped CPU compilation of v123 for part of the experiment. Preserved as qualified trajectory evidence, not used for the performance claim. v123 timing ran after compilation and GPU correctness checks ended.

v123 full solver memcheck aborts in initial conditional IR before new retained-IPM resources are entered: CUDA999,104 errors,102 outstanding allocations after abort. Full solver not sanitizer-qualified.
v122 allocates retained cuBLAS workspace during prepare; v123 allocates it at resource creation to make ownership explicit and independently testable.

Initial unscaled interleaving test kept k=1 despite changed objective coefficients. Final scaled variant explicitly enables three Ruiz iterations and verifies32 distinct k values with exact four-way parity. Ruiz-enabled diagnostic setup uses the host reference API.
Retained workspace execution is bound to its creating host thread and CUDA device; migration/reentrant entry fails explicitly. Each workspace retains32MiB of cuBLAS workspace plus scalar scratch.
Initial Lambda check failed because temporary SSH key was absent. Key restored securely and separate read-only retry confirms H100100%,1607MiB. No campaign mutation, offload or new paid instance.
